response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and open-source development skills with a focus on modern web and cloud technologies, but lacks direct experience with the core requirements of this role: C++ on Windows, SQL Server/Oracle, and capital markets/fixed income domain expertise. His background is more aligned with web, mobile, and embedded systems, which limits his immediate fit for this specialized financial systems role.
strengths: Extensive experience with modern software development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and tooling.
Strong communication skills and knowledge-sharing, as evidenced by workshops, talks, and open-source contributions.
Diverse technical background with exposure to multiple languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, D, Java) and domains (GIS, real-time systems).
concerns: No demonstrated experience with C++ on Windows or SQL Server/Oracle, which are mandatory for the role.
Lacks domain expertise in capital markets, investment banking, or fixed income (no relevant projects or roles listed).
Recent work focuses heavily on TypeScript/Node.js and AI tooling, diverging from the role's core requirements.
